verdict.rationale: LM Studio's 'Bionic' assistant lets users delegate document-editing and agentic tasks (voice, MCP-connected, frontier models) per vendor docs, and one hands-on report confirms it 'works great' as an agentic harness, though with UX rough edges (unclear working directory, no way to preload/unload model) and other community reports note MCP agentic flows getting stuck in loops.
